dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire I don't like skinny as a hanger of clothes or muscular as a bodybuilder. A woman needs to have some soft and tender flesh to be able to hug her with pleasure.

@dogecoin_empire But you have legs so long they reach the sky. Youth is wonderful, so enjoy it as much as you can. And when your youth is over, don't worry, because then you will become a mature woman with the taste of the finest wine.
